title: Find out why the title rows walk starts a part half a second early on some runs
goal: A check that drags the start of a title part fails on some runs because the part starts half a second earlier than expected before anything is dragged. Find out whether the app places the part differently from run to run, or the check is at fault.
notes: Command: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/timeline-sub-layer-rows-walk.json --no-build, run alone five times on 2026-11-25: 2 failed, 3 passed. Output of both failures: [31 dragPart] FAILED: Subtitle starts at 0.95s into the title after the drag, not 1.45s (it started at 0.45s). Also failed once in pass 3 of an-edit-with-50-tracks-and-100-clips-scrolls-pla on 2026-11-24. Not checked against an older build.
acceptance: What makes the Subtitle start at 0.45 s on some runs and 0.95 s on others is named, with two logs side by side
timeline-sub-layer-rows-walk passes ten runs in a row, or the app bug behind it is fixed
